author: nexhub
description: 再漫画（manhua.zaimanhua.com）在线漫画源，直连站点 JSON API（更新列表 / 筛选分类 / 搜索 / 详情 / 章节 / 图片），无需渲染 HTML。

latest.script: function parseList(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var list = []; if (!data || !data.data) return list; var arr = data.data.comicList || []; for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){ var it = arr[i]; if (!it || !it.id) continue; var cover = it.cover || ''; if (cover.indexOf('//') === 0) cover = 'https:' + cover; list.push({ id: String(it.id), title: it.name || '', cover: cover, detailUrl: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/details/' + it.id, author: it.authors || '', status: it.status || '', tags: it.types || '', updateInfo: it.last_update_chapter_name || '', updateChapterId: String(it.last_update_chapter_id || '') }); } return list; }

explore.script: function parseList(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var list = []; if (!data || !data.data) return list; var arr = data.data.comicList || []; for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){ var it = arr[i]; if (!it || !it.id) continue; var cover = it.cover || ''; if (cover.indexOf('//') === 0) cover = 'https:' + cover; list.push({ id: String(it.id), title: it.name || '', cover: cover, detailUrl: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/details/' + it.id, author: it.authors || '', status: it.status || '', tags: it.types || '', updateInfo: it.last_update_chapter_name || '', updateChapterId: String(it.last_update_chapter_id || '') }); } return list; }

category.script: function parseCategory(html, context){ var ctx = context || {}; var base = ctx.baseUrl || 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com'; var page = ctx.page || '1'; var theme = ctx.theme || '0'; var audience = ctx.audience || '0'; var status = ctx.status || '0'; var cate = ctx.cate || '0'; var firstLetter = ctx.firstLetter || ''; var url = base + '/api/v1/comic1/filter?channel=pc&app_name=zmh&version=1.0.0&sortType=0&page=' + page + '&size=18&status=' + status + '&audience=' + audience + '&theme=' + theme + '&cate=' + cate + '&firstLetter=' + firstLetter; return { __meta: true, __fetchUrl: url, __processor: '__processCategory' }; } function __processCategory(data){ var list = []; try { var arr = (data && data.data && data.data.comicList) || []; for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){ var it = arr[i]; if (!it || !it.id) continue; var cover = it.cover || ''; if (cover.indexOf('//') === 0) cover = 'https:' + cover; list.push({ id: String(it.id), title: it.name || '', cover: cover, detailUrl: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/details/' + it.id, author: it.authors || '', status: it.status || '', tags: it.types || '', updateInfo: it.last_update_chapter_name || '' }); } } catch(e){} return list; }

search.script: function parseSearch(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var list = []; if (!data || !data.data) return list; var arr = data.data.list || []; for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++){ var it = arr[i]; if (!it || !it.id) continue; var cover = it.cover || ''; if (cover.indexOf('//') === 0) cover = 'https:' + cover; list.push({ id: String(it.id), title: it.title || it.name || '', cover: cover, detailUrl: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/details/' + it.id, author: it.authors || '', status: it.status || '', tags: it.types || '', updateInfo: it.last_update_chapter_name || '' }); } return list; }

detail.script: function parseDetail(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var info = (data && data.data && data.data.comicInfo) || null; if (!info) return { id: (context && context.id) || '', title: '', cover: '', description: '', author: '', status: '', tags: [] }; var cover = info.cover || ''; if (cover.indexOf('//') === 0) cover = 'https:' + cover; var tags = []; if (info.themeTagList && info.themeTagList.length){ for (var i = 0; i < info.themeTagList.length; i++){ if (info.themeTagList[i] && info.themeTagList[i].tagName) tags.push(info.themeTagList[i].tagName); } } else if (info.types){ tags = String(info.types).split(/[,，/]/); } var author = ''; if (info.authorsTagList && info.authorsTagList.length){ var a = []; for (var j = 0; j < info.authorsTagList.length; j++){ if (info.authorsTagList[j] && info.authorsTagList[j].tagName) a.push(info.authorsTagList[j].tagName); } author = a.join(', '); } else if (info.authors){ author = info.authors; } var status = ''; if (info.statusTagList && info.statusTagList.length && info.statusTagList[0] && info.statusTagList[0].tagName) status = info.statusTagList[0].tagName; else if (info.status) status = info.status; return { id: String(info.id), title: info.title || '', cover: cover, description: info.description || '', author: author, status: status, tags: tags, detailUrl: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/details/' + info.id }; }

chapters.script: function parseChapters(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var list = []; var info = (data && data.data && data.data.comicInfo) || null; if (!info) return list; var comicId = String(info.id); var comicPy = info.comicPy || ''; var groups = info.chapterList || []; for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g++){ var grp = groups[g]; if (!grp || !grp.data) continue; for (var i = 0; i < grp.data.length; i++){ var ch = grp.data[i]; if (!ch || !ch.chapter_id) continue; var cid = String(ch.chapter_id); var title = ch.chapter_title || ('第' + (ch.chapter_order || '')); list.push({ id: comicId + '@' + cid, title: title, url: 'https://manhua.zaimanhua.com/view/' + comicPy + '/' + comicId + '/' + cid, updatedAt: ch.updatetime || 0 }); } } return list; }

images.script: function parseImages(html, context){ var data = html; if (typeof html === 'string'){ try { data = JSON.parse(html); } catch(e){ data = null; } } var list = []; var info = (data && data.data && data.data.chapterInfo) || null; if (!info || !info.page_url) return list; for (var i = 0; i < info.page_url.length; i++){ var u = info.page_url[i]; if (!u) continue; list.push(String(u)); } return list; }
